A [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> was a '''Chosen''', one of Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the Chosen participated in the<ref name="Choices" /> [[battle for Poln Major]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during which the Storm-hair and several other Chosen attempted to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]], in an attempt to bring the Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], Esva's nemesis, to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]].<ref name="Choices" />

The Storm-hairs attacked the [[Whistling Wind]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]], where Ferrouz was hiding with five former [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that formed the [[Hand of Judgment]] group. After Thrawn traveled to the Poln [[Star system/Legends|system]], the Chosen announced that they no longer needed to murder Ferrouz and told the stormtroopers' [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]], [[Daric LaRone]], that they would be leaving after avenging the Storm-hairs the Hand of Jugdment had killed by destroying the tapcafe with explosives. However, members of the [[Troukree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] disabled the explosives before they could be activated.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chosen's voice appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
